fusions.name: Wallowing Shove
fusions.desc: Shoulders every enemy within 3 tiles with your full bulk, dealing 10 damage, pushing each 2 tiles back, slowing it by 30% and stripping 10% of its armour for 6 seconds, with a 50% chance to leave each [Hindered] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Slow Heavy Hoof
fusions.desc: An unhurried, heavy kick that deals 30 damage and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 6 seconds. If it hits, every ally deals 15% more damage for 20 seconds.

fusions.name: Easy Amble
fusions.desc: Reduces the damage you take by 25% for 12 seconds and restores 10 health.

fusions.name: Drifting Bulk
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 10%, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.
